messages.accountMembershipMustBelongToSameAccount: Only account memberships from the same Chat Account can be linked to this Inbox.
messages.chatwootTeamMustBelongToSameAccount: Only Chatwoot teams from the same Chat Account can be linked to this Inbox.

tooltips.chatwootTeams: Chatwoot teams linked to this inbox. Members of linked teams automatically become inbox collaborators in Chatwoot (department-scoped inbox access).

tooltips.emailFetchOwner: Which side polls IMAP. Dual-fetch is always avoided; Chatwoot is the default owner.
